pr_title: [Refactor][WIP] Refactor mla_v1 by moving all MLA preprocessing ops into mla_v1 attention impl
source_quote:
you could use python dataclass instead of NamedTuple
PrefillMLAPreprocessResult and DecodeMLAPreprocessResult has some common fields, you could extract a base class
Can the variable be unified into one like 'enable_prefetch'?

rule.description: 当多个返回值结构存在公共字段时，应使用 Python dataclass 替代 NamedTuple，并提取公共基类以减少代码重复，提高可维护性。
checkpoints: 多个结果类是否存在重复字段

antipattern.code:
# 评审人 Ronald1995: "you could use python dataclass instead of NamedTuple"
# 评审人 Ronald1995: "PrefillMLAPreprocessResult and DecodeMLAPreprocessResult
#   has some common fields, you could extract a base class"

from typing import NamedTuple, Optional
import torch

class PrefillMLAPreprocessResult(NamedTuple):
    """Prefill MLA preprocess result."""
    query: torch.Tensor
    key: torch.Tensor
    value: torch.Tensor
    attn_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor]
    seq_len: int

class DecodeMLAPreprocessResult(NamedTuple):
    """Decode MLA preprocess result."""
    query: torch.Tensor
    key: torch.Tensor
    value: torch.Tensor
    attn_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor]
    # 两个类存在重复字段（query, key, value, attn_mask）
    # 未提取公共基类
